comments.value: I think it could be abused to be really flashy and distracting, maybe have it only animate when speaking or when it's directly looked at?
What they should do is let you set png icons for free, and with plus you can set gifs.
@{5f60c25b2549bb5382979d64|full_name}: though I'm fairly sure unity doesn't support gifs. so it would need to be a texture sheet with a shader to animate it.
Higher resource usage would be a bummer.

@{58c6cbcffd04b1785f747b6c|full_name}: bro I think you might've forgotten about how uh... this game is riddled with extremely poor performance user creations everywhere. Gif playback on panels would have minimal drawback in comparison.

details: It would be nice to have gif support for the icons. What do you think?
title: GIF support for VRC+ icons
